title: 1 — WriterApp UAT
description: Connect an isolated local WriterApp instance; verify runtime build and dedicated account; implement create/save/reopen, synopsis, edit/reopen, sharing/acceptance, and save-failure recovery. Record step evidence and fixture identities. Complete when all five workflows are repeatable and reviewable. Current work: configuration, preflight checks, and the first persistence adapter.

title: 2 — Feedback-to-fix cycle
description: Persist editable improvement jobs; execute Codex in isolated Git worktrees; stream progress; build and launch the changed app; verify runtime build identity; rerun the original test and link the evidence. Complete when one real WriterApp improvement completes the full cycle with fresh human acceptance. No automatic merge or deployment.

title: 3 — Virtual Company UAT
description: Implemented test-company creation and draft-permission persistence using the real Virtual Company Web/API with disposable SQLite, owner/employee identities and a reference company. Validated role/company boundaries and an actual Codex worktree, changed build and linked passing rerun. Human acceptance remains pending. Production SQL Server and external providers are outside this first workflow.

title: 4 — Operational polish and reliability
description: Implemented standalone run heartbeat, cancellation, deadlines, background recovery and owned process supervision; transactional review audit; paginated history and run comparison; explicit evidence retention and reviewed clean worktree cleanup with recovery journals. Validated repeated cycles, worker death, stale leases, restart, partial cleanup, dirty/path refusal and desktop/mobile flows. Local-only operation; remote authentication remains conditional on future hosting.

title: 5 — Application manifests and reproducible configuration
description: Implemented versioned JSON manifests and a trusted registry around the existing adapters. New runs retain the manifest, workflow and binding fingerprints, adapter version and worker identity. Linked reruns keep original definitions and rebind the isolated target and fixture. Incompatible workers are refused, passing application results retain typed resource references, and SQLite schema 7 preserves legacy history without inventing provenance. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 5.

title: 6 — Configurable runtime, identity and fixtures
description: Implemented bounded runtime checks, separate named test sessions and opt-in isolated fixture setup and teardown. Configured runs verify the target and identities before setup and after execution. The worker deletes only run-owned resources and records cleanup outcomes. Existing registered adapters retain their browser workflows. A disposable host smoke covers polling, session isolation, drift, partial setup and ownership refusal. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 6.

title: 7 — Declarative workflow execution
description: Implemented version 2 authored browser and API workflows with bounded actions, correlated response capture, named API sessions, restricted variables and versioned extensions. Runs retain stable steps, screenshots, traces, HTTP observations and independent acceptance. The verified version 1 engine remains available. A disposable smoke covers create/save/reopen with backend readback, stepped review, cancellation and rejected unsafe inputs. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 7.

title: 8 — Trusted build and launch recipes
description: Implemented trusted versioned build and launch recipes for improvement jobs and case validation. Registered WriterApp and Virtual Company extensions retain existing host behavior, and local Node process recipes use bounded arguments and owned processes. Jobs record recipe and artifact fingerprints, verify source and sealed outputs, and rerun the original workflow on a fresh isolated target. Test-only apps remain runnable with implementation blocked. Disposable job checks cover two recipe shapes and failure recovery. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 8.

title: 9 — Dashboard configuration and readiness
description: Implemented manifest-driven application setup, local definition revisions, authorized recipe selection and read-only preflight. Imported workflows require two passing qualification runs for the exact workflow, manifest and saved binding. Reviews retain frozen versions and independent acceptance. Desktop and mobile smoke checks cover readiness gates, concurrent edits and historical provenance. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 9.

title: 10 — Integration migration and third-application proof
description: Implemented version 2 workflows for the demo, WriterApp and Virtual Company. The migration retains stable steps, legacy snapshots and explicit custom extensions. The automated suite and fresh isolated WriterApp and Virtual Company builds passed. Sample Notes onboards through definitions and a trusted local recipe and passes synthetic and real Codex feedback, build and frozen rerun checks with pending acceptance. See docs/roadmap.md milestone 10.
